title: Hinton in Orlando: a new session at Francis's home
summary: Hinton states the date and location and talks about Francis's upcoming Michael's Pub engagement.

blocks.x: This is Sunday, September 13, 1978, here in Orlando, Florida, in Disneyworld, and I'm continuing my talk with Panama Francis, and I started in Nice, France. I
been down here a week, and I've been over to Panama Francis' beautiful home here in Orlando, Florida, where he lives, and it's just fantastic.
Panama is finishing an engagement down here, and he's returning to New York to open at Michael's Pub. When are you going to Michael's Pub, Panama?
I open at Michael's Pub on August 28th with Eddie Woodie Barefield.

With Eddie Woodie Barefield, huh? Great. Well, man, I tell you -- it was a joy seeing your lovely place, and to see how great success has been for you down here all through this music business. Considering the troubles and what the music business is like, this is really a joy to see.
